item.title: RAITE 2026 - Programming Challenge
description: Regional Assembly on Information Technology Education 2026 - PSITE Central Luzon
Pampanga State University - Don Honorio Ventura Campus
The programming challenge consisted of two pair of student from different schools. It used CodeChum platform where the event was conducted.
Failed passing the hard programming problems which included problems that require solving with various graph algorithms such as A*.

Practiced various algorithms with NeetCode a month before the event, but it was extremely lacking since I was busy on building a system for our thesis project. Thus, largely contributing to the failure to gain rank during the event.

item.title: Robotics 2019
description: Division Training Workshop on Robotics and Intelligent Machine 2019
Consisted of robots developed using Arduino EEE Robot Kit. It uses scratch-like programming language to build the robot logic
Was be able to make the robot walk on to a detected black-colored line.
The robot had a lot of logical errors on its pathfinding while it was being developed.

item.title: Sip and Scale 2026
description: Lilim Café - Sto. Rosario, Angeles City, Pampanga
A networking event with various IT students and professionals who wanted to build a startup.
Failed making rapport with the participants due to the awkward choice of technology, Ethereum (Blockchain Network), wherein most of the participants are leaned towards AI.
Failed communicating and socializing with the participants due to extreme introversion.
